items.source: This method allows setting all XTRIM options at once, including trimming strategies (MAXLEN, MINID) and other parameters. Constructs a new command instance with all previously configured properties except the options, which are replaced by the provided RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions.
items.translation: 此方法允许一次性设置所有 XTRIM 选项，包括修剪策略（MAXLEN、MINID）及其他参数。它会构建一个新的命令实例，包含所有先前配置的属性，但会用提供的 RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions 替换其中的选项。

items.source: since 4.0: Inspect getOptions() -> RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions.getTrimOptions() -> RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions.getTrimStrategy() and obtain the threshold from the concrete strategy instead. For example: if (strategy instanceof MaxLenTrimStrategy m) { m.threshold(); } or if (strategy instanceof MinIdTrimStrategy i) { i.threshold(); }.
items.translation: 自 4.0 版本起：检查 getOptions() -> RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions.getTrimOptions() -> RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions.getTrimStrategy()，并从具体的策略中获取阈值。例如： if (strategy instanceof MaxLenTrimStrategy m) { m.threshold(); } 或 if (strategy instanceof MinIdTrimStrategy i) { i.threshold(); }。

items.source: since 4.0: Inspect getOptions() -> RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions.getTrimOptions() -> RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions.getTrimStrategy() and obtain the threshold from the concrete strategy instead.
items.translation: 自 4.0 版本起：检查 getOptions() -> RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions.getTrimOptions() -> RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions.getTrimStrategy()，并从具体的策略中获取阈值。

items.source: since 4.0: specify a concrete trim strategy (MAXLEN or MINID) via RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions and RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions instead of using this method. Prefer options(XTrimOptions.trim(TrimOptions.maxLen(threshold))) or construct with stream(key, XTrimOptions.trim(TrimOptions.maxLen(threshold))).
items.translation: 自 4.0 版本起：请通过 RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions 和 RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions 指定具体的修剪策略（MAXLEN 或 MINID），而不要使用此方法。推荐使用 options(XTrimOptions.trim(TrimOptions.maxLen(threshold)))，或通过 stream(key, XTrimOptions.trim(TrimOptions.maxLen(threshold))) 进行构造。

items.source: since 4.0: do not toggle the trim operator in isolation. Specify a concrete trim strategy (MAXLEN or MINID) and operator via RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions and RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions, e.g. options(XTrimOptions.trim(TrimOptions.maxLen(n).approximate())) or options(XTrimOptions.trim(TrimOptions.minId(id).exact())).
items.translation: 自 4.0 版本起：请勿单独切换修剪运算符。请通过 RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions 和 RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions 指定具体的修剪策略（MAXLEN 或 MINID）及运算符，例如： options(XTrimOptions.trim(TrimOptions.maxLen(n).approximate())) 或 options(XTrimOptions.trim(TrimOptions.minId(id).exact()))。

items.source: since 4.0: do not toggle the trim operator in isolation. Specify a concrete trim strategy (MAXLEN or MINID) and operator via RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions and RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions, e.g. options(XTrimOptions.trim(TrimOptions.maxLen(n).approximate())).
items.translation: 自 4.0 版本起：请勿单独切换修剪运算符。请通过 RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions 和 RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions 指定具体的修剪策略（MAXLEN 或 MINID）及运算符，例如： options(XTrimOptions.trim(TrimOptions.maxLen(n).approximate()))。

items.source: since 4.0: specify a concrete trim strategy (MAXLEN or MINID) via RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions and RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions instead of using this method.
items.translation: 自 4.0 版本起：请通过RedisStreamCommands.XTrimOptions和RedisStreamCommands.TrimOptions指定具体的修剪策略（MAXLEN 或 MINID），而不要使用此方法。
